entries.summary: TWIST, a privacy-preserving scheme for cloud-based large language models, was accepted to ACM CCS 2026. Developed by ByteDance and City University of Hong Kong, it employs joint model-token transformations to obfuscate data without requiring trusted hardware. This approach balances privacy and utility, achieving near-zero plaintext leakage in experiments while maintaining standard inference performance. TWIST integrates seamlessly with existing serving engines, offering a practical solution for secure Model-as-a-Service deployments in sensitive enterprise environments.

Supporting over 50 languages, it enables efficient, batch processing for global video localization, ad repurposing, and copyright content management with high accuracy.

entries.summary: OpenViking is a unified context database for AI agents in software development. It preserves persistent context—code repositories, project documents, review guidelines, personal preferences, and learned experiences—across different tools and agents. Rather than copying data between chat apps, CLI tools, and documents, developers can access the same shared context layer via viking:// paths regardless of which agent they use. Agents like Codex, Claude Code, and office IM bots read from and write to this common store, automatically extracting memories from sessions.

entries.summary: CloudLens for TOS is a log observability application that integrates TOS API access logs and storage asset data into a unified framework. It provides two complementary capabilities: access log analysis for real-time troubleshooting, access analysis, and security auditing; and data透视 (data pivot) for capacity planning, cost optimization, and asset governance. Access log analysis covers resource usage,热度统计 (heat statistics), access analysis, security analysis, and检索分析 (search analysis). Data透视 offers daily snapshots of storage assets by region, storage type, bucket, and prefix dimensions. Users can接入 (access) the service through either the TOS or TLS console, with a default free dashboard and advanced prefix analysis available.
